decisions.label: Oligo-dT Primer
decisions.description: DNA primers consisting of 12-18 deoxythymidines that anneal to the poly(A) tails of eukaryotic mRNAs and are used to prime reverse transcription.

verification.note: NCIT:C201929 Oligo-dT Primer; exact label match.

decisions.label: Oligo-dT Primer
decisions.description: DNA primers consisting of deoxythymidines that anneal to the poly(A) tails of eukaryotic mRNAs and are used to prime reverse transcription.

verification.note: Poly-dT (polydeoxythymidine) is functionally equivalent to Oligo-dT; NCIT:C201929 is the best available match. Label differs slightly.

decisions.label: Feature Barcoding
decisions.description: A technology platform that uses oligonucleotide barcodes to simultaneously measure gene expression and other cellular features (surface proteins, T/B cell receptors, CRISPR perturbations) at single-cell resolution.

verification.note: NCIT:C202255 Feature Barcoding; exact label match (case-insensitive). Feature barcoding is used as an RT primer type in single-cell multimodal sequencing.

decisions.label: Random Primer
decisions.description: Short oligonucleotides of random sequence that anneal throughout the length of RNA templates and are used to prime reverse transcription.

verification.note: NCIT:C201930 Random Primer; exact match for random priming in reverse transcription.
